name: Data Import
description: Read data from third-party formats (Minitab .mpx, CSV/TSV/TXT, Excel/ODS, JSON/NDJSON, Q-DAS AQDEF) into a worksheet
whenToUse: When data from a third-party source is to be brought into a data collection; for an agent from CSV or JSON text, with profiles for common measuring-machine exports.
dropHint: or click to choose a file
supportedFormats: Supported formats: Minitab Project (.mpx), CSV / TSV / TXT, Excel (.xlsx/.xlsm/.xls) / ODS, JSON / NDJSON, Q-DAS AQDEF (.dfq/.dfd)
errCsvEmpty: The file contains no readable data rows.
parseErrorDetail: An error occurred while reading the file: {message}
noColumns: No data columns were found in this file.
errZip: File is not a valid ZIP archive.
errMpxStructure: No recognizable Minitab worksheet data found in this file.
errXlsxParse: The Excel / ODS file could not be parsed.
errXlsxEmpty: The Excel / ODS file contains no data sheets.
errJsonParse: The JSON file could not be parsed.
errJsonEmpty: The JSON file contains no data rows.
errJsonStructure: The JSON structure contains no recognizable table (neither records array, NDJSON, nor column-oriented object).
errAqdefEmpty: The AQDEF file contains no readable data.
errAqdefStructure: The AQDEF file contains no recognizable characteristics (K-keys).
useFirstRowAsHeader: Use first row as column headers
parseTimeout: Reading the source takes too long; please try again.
